purpose: Teach: 防護/寄生虫/万引き/罵倒/国策/保釈/喚問/殺傷

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害時の防護服の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of protective suits in disasters, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone with a gentle upward lift. Acknowledging his work with genuine interest. Unhurried pacing, as if inviting him into conversation rather than interrogating.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、寄生虫感染症の医学史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the medical history of parasitic infections.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Small pause before 'Yes' — collecting his thoughts. Clear articulation but not defensive. Straightforward, as if offering the truth as he sees it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、都市部の万引き犯罪統計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on urban shoplifting crime statistics, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle reframing, slightly puzzled but not accusatory. Soft intonation at the end, like she's checking her notes or her memory. Curious rather than correcting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ネット上の罵倒の社会学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper was on the sociology of online harassment and insults.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching honesty. No apology in his voice. Brief and direct, stating fact. Slight firmness underneath — he knows what he wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国策事業の歴史的影響を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered the historical impact of national policy initiatives in your work, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged but measured. Leaning in slightly with interest. Testing him gently — the question carries warmth but also attentiveness, like she's truly following the thread of his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦後の保釈制度の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper examined the postwar bail system and its development.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'postwar' — marking the historical specificity. Voice steady and clear, neither rushing nor dragging. He's stating his focus with scholarly precision.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、国会喚問の歴史的事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper looked at historical cases of Diet summons, correct?
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. A hint of searching in her voice, as if she's cross-referencing her memory. Warm but careful, neither condemning nor excusing. Letting silence sit a moment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の殺傷統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper focused on casualty statistics during wartime.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact closing. No flinching. Final answer delivered with composure. Brief trailing off, as if that settles it — all the cards on the table now.
